methodology: This is an independent fan guide, not an official Portable Moose site. Release and platform details are kept in step with Portable Moose and storefront pages. Chapter routes focus on reproducible in-game steps, while character pages avoid fan theories and unsupported plot claims.

factSources.name: Sally Face Press Kit
factSources.usedFor: Original episode dates, platforms, mobile launch, languages, rating, game description, and press-kit screenshots.
factSources.note: The Fast Facts table lists Episode Five as December 13, 2019. A 2020 date appearing once in the narrative history is contradicted by the official 2019 launch news and is treated as a typo.

factSources.name: Episode Five launch announcement
factSources.usedFor: Confirms the December 13, 2019 release of Memories and Dreams.
factSources.note: Used to resolve the date inconsistency inside the current Press Kit.

factSources.name: Sally Face 2 Press Kit
factSources.usedFor: TBD release date, single-player format, Steam Early Access first, later console/mobile plans, team history, and all sequel screenshots.
factSources.note: No unannounced date or platform promise is inferred.

factSources.name: Portable Moose FAQ
factSources.usedFor: Confirms that Sal is male and that the Sally Face 2 date remains TBA.
factSources.note: Also confirms Sanity's Fall is a fictional in-world band.

factSources.name: Sally Face Steam store listing
factSources.usedFor: 35-achievement count, PC features, 12 supported languages, mature-content notice, and current Windows/macOS/Linux requirements.
factSources.note: Steam's December 14, 2016 date is the Steam launch; the Press Kit's August 16 date is the original Episode One release.

factSources.name: Steam global achievements
factSources.note: Unlock routes are checked separately because the stats page does not explain every condition.

factSources.name: Complete Guide in English
factSources.usedFor: Cross-checks all 35 unlock routes, Episode Three codes, Episode Four runes and tapes, and Episode Five color/puzzle routes.
factSources.note: Community-authored; only reproducible gameplay instructions are used.

factSources.usedFor: Confirms the 5364 clue order, batteries, Gear Boy, and hidden-sighting route.
